issues.title: Add CONTRIBUTING.md
issues.prompt: Create a new file CONTRIBUTING.md at the repository root with a short (3-5 bullets) guide on how to contribute to this MCP server project: how to run tests (npm test), how to run the server (npm start), and that the code lives in src/. Commit it on this branch. Reply TASK_COMPLETE when done.

issues.title: Add npm script 'typecheck'
issues.prompt: Edit package.json to add an npm script named "typecheck" that runs `node --check server.js && node --check src/schema.js && node --check src/client.js && node --check src/docs.js`. Do not change any other scripts or fields. Commit it on this branch. Reply TASK_COMPLETE when done.
